topics.title: The Testing Pyramid
topics.content:
### How Much of Each Type to Write

```
           ▲
          /E2E\
         / Few  \
        /────────\
       /  Integr. \
      /   Some     \
     /──────────────\
    /   Unit Tests   \
   /   Many, fast    \
  /──────────────────\
```

| Type | Speed | Cost | What it tests |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Unit** | Very fast (ms) | Cheap | Individual functions/components |
| **Integration** | Medium (seconds) | Medium | Multiple units working together |
| **E2E** | Slow (minutes) | Expensive | Full user flows in a real browser |

#### What to Test at Each Level

**Unit tests**: Pure functions, business logic, React components in isolation.

**Integration tests**: API routes with a real database, service interactions.

**E2E tests**: Critical user journeys: signup flow, checkout, login.
